corrections.reason: The Ge'ez plural object suffix on 'አግብእ' is 7th-order 'ኦ' ('አግብኦሙ', 'hand them over'), contrasting the singular verb 'አግብእ' with the plural 'አግብኦሙ', which is clearly visible in the print.
The printed glyph has the 3rd-order horizontal foot stroke 'ሂ' ('አካሂዷ'), consistent with 'ሂደች' (L04) and 'አካሂዳችን' (Col 4 L08).

corrections.old_text: ያን፡ ጊዜ፡ ሰዎች፡ ሁሉ፡ በባሕር፡ ሊሄዱ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ያን፡ ጊዜ፡ ሰዎች፡ ሁሉ፡ በባሕር፡ ሊሂዱ ፡
corrections.reason: The printed text uses the 3rd-order 'ሂ' ('ሊሂዱ') rather than 5th-order 'ሄ'.
The printed glyph is 1st-order 'የ' ('ብየ') without a 5th-order loop, matching 'ብየ' two lines below in L19.
The Ge'ez noun for harbor/port is 'መርስ' with 6th-order 'ስ' (as seen in Col 3 L19 and L23), and the image clearly shows the bent top-left of 'ስ' rather than 'ሶ'.
